summary: Join our Market Systems Development Training Course to gain essential skills for fostering market growth and enhancing economic resilience in your community.
lede: Market systems development examines how interconnected markets function and how relationships, incentives, rules, and services can change. For market development managers, value chain advisors, monitoring and evaluation specialists, and programme leaders, the training supports diagnosing constraints and designing adaptive interventions. You practise market mapping and political economy analysis, build results chains and measurement plans using the M4P approach and DCED Standard for Results Measurement, and plan facilitation and adaptive management.
audienceIntro: Market systems development training suits professionals who influence market actors, support inclusive economic growth, or measure whether interventions create durable change across complex value chains.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: No formal market systems development qualification is required. You should have basic experience in programme design, value chain work, enterprise support, livelihoods, inclusive finance, monitoring and evaluation, or partnership management. Familiarity with spreadsheets helps, but advanced Excel, Power BI, coding, and statistical modelling are not required. Completion requirements: You will complete guided market analysis, intervention design, measurement, and reporting exercises. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted evidence review receive operational application treatment, not technical engineering treatment.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
